verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Brevo serves an llms.txt at developers.brevo.com (HTTP 200) containing an explicit "Instructions for AI Agents" section. A second probe confirms docs pages are available as clean Markdown by appending .md, and the llms.txt indexes topical guides (batch sends, sandbox mode, n8n, Supabase). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents successfully consuming these docs, and no visible llms-full.txt or full-corpus file in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote:
